participants.name: SME Business Owner / Director
participants.role_in_journey: LC applicant. Submits LC application via trade finance portal or via Relationship Manager. Receives status notifications at each phase. Issues discrepancy waiver instructions in ALT-003. Receives settlement confirmation.

touchpoints.channel: CH-008 Corporate Banking Portal or RM-assisted
touchpoints.action: Submits LC application with trade details, beneficiary, goods description, HS codes, Incoterms, and required document list
Receives LC issuance confirmation with SWIFT reference and expiry date

touchpoints.channel: CH-008 Corporate Banking Portal or RM contact
touchpoints.action: Receives document examination result; issues discrepancy waiver instruction if applicable (ALT-003)
Receives settlement confirmation — account debit amount and SWIFT reimbursement reference

participants.name: Relationship Manager
participants.role_in_journey: Assists PER-002 in submitting LC applications in the RM-assisted channel. Advises on discrepancy waiver decisions (ALT-003). Handles credit referrals in PH-053 for out-of-limit requests. Escalation point for compliance holds.

touchpoints.action: Submits LC application on customer behalf (rm_assisted channel)
Escalation point for out-of-limit LC requests — coordinates with PER-056 if credit referral required
Advises PER-002 on discrepancy waiver decision — explains UCP 600 Article 16 implications

participants.name: Credit Analyst
participants.role_in_journey: Reviews out-of-limit LC applications in PH-053 where the LC face value exceeds the customer's approved trade finance sub-limit. Not in the happy path (which is in-limit).

touchpoints.action: Assesses customer financial position for out-of-limit LC request; produces credit decision for approval by committee or senior RM

participants.name: MLRO (Money Laundering Reporting Officer)
participants.role_in_journey: Receives alert when SVC-051 detects a sanctions hit (EXC-001) or TBML concern. Reviews and authorises (or confirms block on) compliance holds. Not in the happy path.

touchpoints.action: Receives sanctions hit or TBML alert with full screening details. Reviews LC application. Confirms block or authorises override with documented justification.

participants.name: Trade Finance Operations
participants.role_in_journey: Receives physical or electronic document presentations (PH-056). Performs UCP 600 document examination within 5-banking-day deadline (PH-057). Records examination result via API. Must hold CDCS (Certified Documentary Credit Specialist) or equivalent qualification.

touchpoints.channel: Trade Finance portal — operations view, physical document receipt
touchpoints.action: Logs received document set via POST /trade-finance/lc-applications/{id}/presentations
Examines all documents against LC terms using UCP 600 / ISBP 745. Records examination result (compliant or discrepant with specific article citations).

participants.name: Trade Finance Service
participants.role_in_journey: Primary service owner for JRN-013. Owns all LC lifecycle entities. Orchestrates all phases. Enforces UCP 600 deadlines.

participants.name: Commercial Banking Core
participants.role_in_journey: Same-capability peer service. Provides facility headroom data and account debit for settlement.

participants.name: Sanctions Screening Service
participants.role_in_journey: Cross-capability compliance gate. Screens beneficiary and goods on EVT-076. Returns EVT-077 on clearance.

participants.name: International Payments Service
participants.role_in_journey: Cross-capability SWIFT adapter. Transmits MT700 on EVT-078 and MT202 reimbursement on EVT-081.

participants.name: Advising Bank (Beneficiary's Bank)
participants.role_in_journey: Receives SWIFT MT700 at PH-055 (notifies beneficiary of LC). Forwards presented documents to issuing bank at PH-056. Receives SWIFT MT202/MT910 reimbursement at PH-058.

touchpoints.action: Receives MT700, advises beneficiary of LC terms
Forwards beneficiary's documents to issuing bank

participants.name: Beneficiary (Seller / Exporter)
participants.role_in_journey: Ships goods and presents compliant documents to advising bank (PH-056). May communicate discrepancy waiver acceptance (ALT-002/ALT-003).

touchpoints.action: Receives notification of LC issuance from advising bank
Presents shipping documents to advising bank within presentation period
